title: Polynomial Vaughan recombination and the actual one-sided prime margin
objective: Determine the precise pointwise prime-target content of the polynomial-sifted coefficient estimates after full Vaughan recombination, and attempt a genuinely sufficient one-sided inequality rather than substituting a composite-input comparison for the Goldbach margin.
deliverables: At most two exact original-target claims
A sufficient one-sided estimate or exact first obstruction
Separate mathematical challenge and bounded revision
success_criteria: The original prime variable and complement remain distinguished
Composite cancellations and prime powers are retained
A positive comparison term is never assumed to control an unbounded signed remainder
Every proposed inequality has the true pointwise H/log²H target scale
stop_conditions: One pair round within8 proxy units
No paid inference, publication, external messages or unbounded experiments
Failure to close an inequality does not relax the full Goldbach objective
